name: pencil-mcp
notes: Host-managed, explicit-only (AM-0006). Hosts attach the stable launcher (launch.mjs), which resolves the live AppImage mount from the running desktop process at spawn time. The launcher never auto-launches the AppImage (PENCIL_MCP_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 required) and never spawns a second instance; it detects cross-session singleton conflicts via an advisory instance lock and returns CONFLICT/NEEDS_USER instead of dragging the window between desktops. When launching, the new window is placed on the originating session workspace with a non-activating move only. Persisted /tmp/.mount_Pen.* paths are prohibited: they go stale on every app restart (ENOENT). Bounded startup timeout, real MCP handshake verification, and honest BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER diagnostics are required. The harness never installs the Pencil desktop application itself.
